text: Sentra Healthcare AI: The Official Agent Reference Handbook 1. FOUNDATIONS, PHILOSOPHY, & THE CORE MISSION Sentra AI represents a strategic architectural intervention against systemic vulnerabilities in the healthcare landscape. Originating in February 2025 as a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiative of RSIA Melinda DHAI in Kediri, Indonesia, the system was designed by dr. Ferdi Iskandar to address the high-pressure environments of frontline primary care and secondary hospitals. It was born not as a replacement for clinical intuition, but as a response to the fact that medical knowledge is now too vast for any single human mind to synthesize under acute time constraints.Sentra AI is built to dismantle the "Tiga Terlambat" (Three Delays) thesis, a framework identifying the critical failure points in patient outcomes: 1. Delay in Decision-Making: Occurring when clinicians lack synthesized, real-time clarity to recognize subtle physiological drift. 2. Delay in Referral Escalation: Resulting from the absence of proactive risk mapping before a patient breaches a critical threshold. 3. Delay in Definitive Care: Stemming from administrative friction and information asymmetry during facility transitions.The core operating philosophy is defined by the principle: "The doctor decides. Sentra clarifies." We operate on a model of Augmented Intelligence , where technology functions as a cognitive extension of the clinician. The system is governed by three non-negotiable pillars: ● The Doctor Leads Context: Human empathy, ethical reasoning, and clinical judgment are the final authority. ● AI Supports Information: Sentra puckers the "noise" of fragmented data to provide prioritized clinical signals. ● Safety Through Accountability: Every output is auditable, probabilistic, and designed for medical-legal defensibility.This philosophical rigor is necessary to distinguish our mission from the noise of the global health-tech market, where brand confusion can lead to critical operational risks. 2. TAXONOMY: CLEARING GLOBAL BRAND CONFUSION Precise brand taxonomy is vital for clinical safety and operational clarity. THE SEVEN COMPUTING PROTOCOLS (PROTOCOLS 7) The Sentra AI engine is a modular system that standardizes clinical workflows through seven independent computing layers. This architecture allows for targeted, auditable interventions across the patient journey. P-01: Synthesia Engine ● Mathematical Representation: P(yᵢ | x) = softmax(Wh + b)ᵢ ● Clinical Significance: A Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework that normalizes unstructured clinical narratives (e.g., doctor notes, slang, local acronyms) into standardized medical entities ready for Bayesian analysis. ● Performance Metric: High-fidelity normalization to global vocabularies. P-02: Bayesian Algorithm ● Mathematical Representation: P(D|S) = P(S|D) · P(D) / P(S) ● Clinical Significance: A probability engine calculating differential diagnosis likelihood by synthesizing symptoms with regional epidemiology and patient-specific risk factors to prevent cognitive closure. P-03: Clinical Trajectory ● Mathematical Representation: dx/dt = f(x, t, θ) + ε, x(t ₀ ) = x ₀ ● Clinical Significance: An Early-Warning Amplifier using Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) to track physiological drift across multiple encounters. It identifies "phase transitions" before vital signs breach traditional linear thresholds. P-04: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) ● Mathematical Representation: WER = (S + D + I) / N ● Clinical Significance: Extracts structured data from paper lab results and external reports. It targets forensic accuracy to ensure secondary data is reliable for the risk engine. P-05: AI-Powered Pharmaceutical ● Mathematical Representation: v = Vmax · S / (Km + S) ● Clinical Significance: An automated pharmacovigilance layer modeling biochemical kinetics to flag drug-drug interactions, allergies, and contraindications in real-time. P-06: Smart Referral & Auto Documentation ● Mathematical Representation: η = 1 − T_auto / T_manual ● Clinical Significance: Generates discharge summaries and rujukan letters. Validated to achieve a 40% administrative reduction , returning time to direct patient care. P-07: Clinical Prognosis ● Mathematical Representation: h(t|x) = h ₀ (t) · exp(β ₁ x ₁ + β ₂ x ₂ + ··· + β�x�) ● Clinical Significance: Estimates long-term outcome risks via Cox Proportional Hazards, stratifying chronic-care cohorts based on therapy response.While these protocols provide the computing infrastructure, the system's "Thinking Stack" is governed by the advanced risk models developed during our foundational strategy sessions. 4. ADVANCED RISK INTELLIGENCE: THE 'VOSS SESSIONS' The "Voss Sessions"—specifically the recording from 05 July 2026 at 03:00 WIB —marked Sentra’s move from linear monitoring to complex systems theory. This session between dr. Ferdi and the AI entity 'Voss' (mitra teknologi mitra teknologi) established that human biology is non-deterministic and deterioration is often a "phase transition" rather than a straight line. The "Smoke vs. Fire" Analogy Traditional metrics like NEWS2 are "asap" (smoke)—lagging indicators like falling blood pressure that only appear after compensatory mechanisms have failed. Sentra’s intelligence seeks the "api" (fire)—the depletion of the body's Compensatory Reserve —before the "tipping point" is reached. Risk Indices & The Architect's Secret Sauce ● C-STDI (Chronic State-Transition Deterioration Index): A retrospective audit metric used to evaluate the burden of chronic decline. ● FTDR (Forward Transition Deterioration Risk): The prospective, probabilistic risk engine. The FTDR Equation: FTDR_i(t,h) = σBaseRisk_i(t) + λ1 CouplingOnset_i(t) + λ2 CouplingStrength_i(t) + λ3 LagCoupling_i(t) + λ4 MultiSystemSpread_i(t)The framework is built on three technical breakthroughs: 1. Sigmoid Transformation: Mapping dynamic risk to a non-linear probability range (0 to 1), where alerts accelerate rapidly only after critical deviations. 2. Personalized Baselines: Replacing population averages with an individual's specific physiological history to reduce "noise." 3. Residual Correlation & Common-Driver Exclusion: To avoid false positives, dr. Ferdi rejected raw correlation. Sentra uses Corr_residual to calculate Cross-System Coupling only after removing "common drivers" (e.g., external factors affecting both HR and BP). This detects true system de-synchronization.This high-level intelligence—or "The Thinking Stack" —is delivered to the clinician through specific, high-clarity interfaces. 5. INTERACTION SURFACES & INTERFACES Guided by the principle of "Kejernihan sebelum kebisingan" (Clarity before noise), Sentra’s UI/UX is designed to reduce cognitive entropy. ● Sentrapedia: The core medical knowledge base and encyclopaedia. ● SentraWiki: The living documentation for technical protocols and alur kerja. ● Asisten Medis: A browser extension for EMR side-loading, extracting case summaries without disrupting existing workflows. ● Medboard: The centralized dashboard for monitoring real-time risk scores (FTDR) and trajectories. ● Sidelab Terminal: A minimalist CLI version for power users requiring high-speed reasoning. Spotlight: 'Audrey' (Conversational Co-pilot) Audrey serves as the conversational layer of the orchestration engine. ● Sub-2-second latency: Optimized for time-critical ER environments. ● Scope: Mastery of 144+ Indonesian Medical Council (KKI) disease entities. ● The Hard Technical Gate: A strict Zero-Retention Policy . Audrey processes data but never stores Protected Health Information (PHI), acting as a "volatile" intelligence layer.These interfaces are supported by a rigorous legal and safety framework to ensure institutional accountability. 6. OPERATIONAL SAFEGUARDS & MEDICO-LEGAL COMPLIANCE Sentra AI is unique for its multidisciplinary foundation. Founder dr. Ferdi Iskandar (MD, SH, MKN) is not only a clinician but a legal expert and officer of the IDI Kota Kediri BHP2A (Biro Hukum, Pembinaan dan Pembelaan Anggota). This ensures that every line of code is designed for legal auditability under Indonesian law. Safety Gates & Privacy The system deploys 8 Safety Gates that act as hard overrides in the diagnostic flow. Our architecture is fully aligned with UU PDP (Indonesian Data Protection Law), utilizing a zero-retention infrastructure to prevent data leakage.
